Real oracle text (data/fin/fin_scryfall.json #61, verified unchanged): "Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains hexproof until end of turn. Untap it." Instant, {U} — both verified against fin_scryfall.json, unchanged. definition.ts already fully declarative (pumpTarget/grantKeywordTarget/untapTarget, all owner:'you') from an earlier pass — no engine/card.ts change needed this time.

Facts (5 source, 1 sink), all annotations baked via compute-annotations.mjs off a new annotations-authoring.json, value resolved for real via compute-weights.mjs --slug=magic-damper (all 6 facts -> 1, steep-bucketed real magnitude): self-cast {event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'} and self-graveyard {to:'Graveyard', controller:'you', subject:'self'} (both typeLine-anchored on 'Instant', mirroring restoration-magic's identical Instant-with-no-permanent-self-presence pair). pump {event:'pump', controller:'you', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}, targeted:true, untilEndOfTurn:true} and grantKeyword Hexproof {event:'grantKeyword', keyword:'Hexproof', controller:'you', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}, targeted:true, untilEndOfTurn:true} both directly mirror Summon: Primal Garuda's own real 'target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains flying until end of turn' precedent (controller:'you' expresses the printed 'you control' restriction on the target — Constraints itself has no controller field, only Fact does). New real vocabulary this pass: {event:'untap', controller:'you', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}, targeted:true} — NO untilEndOfTurn (untapping is instantaneous, not a duration effect). 'untap' was previously in verify-synergy.mjs's PARKED_ACTION_FNS (no fact vocabulary at all, despite card.ts's own untapTarget Effect kind — added specifically for this card in an earlier pass — being fully real/executable via actions.untap/state.untap) — promoted it the same way pump/tap/animate/gainControl/surveil were each promoted earlier: producedEvents' new case 'untap' (reuses sideOf's name-guessing fallback, same as tap before its own controller field existed — harness.ts's loggingActions.untap logs no controller field), removed from PARKED_ACTION_FNS, added to explainableFns. Sink (reshaped from old v1 zone->to): {to:'Battlefield', controller:'you', types:{has:['Creature']}} — Magic Damper's own real 'wants a creature you control' requirement, unchanged in substance from the pre-migration fact.

Scenarios.ts consolidated to 1 (was 2): dropped the old 'no legal target, nothing happens' no-op branch per the standing 'default to one scenario, no-op branches don't need their own' rule — the single remaining scenario demonstrates all three clauses (pump/hexproof/untap) firing simultaneously against the same real target, real basic function, not branching.
